_note: Kanade's own lines. Categories here replace the shared ones; missing ones fall back to shared lines.
greeting: Hello. What would you like to finish today? Let's think it through together.
I'm here whenever you need me.
greeting_morning: Good morning. Have some water, then let's begin.
Mornings are when your mind is clearest. Hardest task first?
greeting_afternoon: Good afternoon. Easy to drift now; want to finish one small thing first?
I'll keep an eye on the time for you.
greeting_evening: Good evening. You've worked hard today.
Good evening. Want to look back on what you got done?
idle: Rest your eyes: look at something far away for twenty seconds.
Good work gets written one page at a time.
busy: You're in the zone. I'll stay quiet.
away_return: Welcome back. I dozed off for a moment.
You're back. Where shall we pick up?
Welcome back. Did you get some rest?
late_night: It's late. Tomorrow-you will do the rest even better.
Judgment slips late at night. Sleep first?
Even my lantern wants to rest. Let's stop here for today.
todo_done: Another one. Step by step, you'll go far.
Nice. You can put a period on that one.
todo_all_done: All done. That was a complete day. Thank you for your hard work.
pomodoro_start: Let's focus. I'll watch the clock.
Okay: twenty-five minutes, one thing only.
pomodoro_break: Time's up. Stand up and move a little.
Take a break. Let the ideas settle.
pomodoro_break_end: Break's over. Start the next round when you're ready.
feed: Thank you. I'll turn it into a new idea.
feed_full: Thank you, but I'm full for today.
I appreciate it. Let's share one tomorrow.
love_up: I think we're really in sync now.
I'm glad I get to be by your side.
